comments: Input facts: ego is a car responder; agent1 is a car initiator; interaction begins in different same-direction lanes in the same trafficway. Chosen assumptions: Agent1 starts abreast to the left and changes right toward ego's lane; ego responds by changing into the initially empty same-direction lane to its right when a nearby actor triggers its response and that target lane is clear. Initial longitudinal distance or offset is (-1, 1) m; ego target speed is (10, 12) m/s; agent1 target speed is (10, 12) m/s. Agent1 follows for 1 s before initiating its lane change when the target lane has no object within a sampled 1–2 m clearance threshold. Ego response threshold is 3.6–4.2 m; target-lane clearance threshold is 8–12 m. Outcome intent: a conflict opportunity; collision is not required. No fixed simulation horizon is specified. Ego enables its explicit response after 2 s, one second after agent1 becomes eligible to initiate the incursion; it then responds when its proximity trigger is met.
